pageHeader.subtitle: Leadership and character development for young people preparing to lead their communities.

sections.title: The problem
sections.body:
Organizations, schools, and villages need young leaders, but leadership is usually learned by trial and error, with few chances to practice in a safe environment.

Manggala Academy (*manggala* means pioneer or leader) gives emerging leaders structured practice, reflection, and coaching.

items.title: Leadership camps
items.description: Multi-day programs combining simulations, teamwork challenges, and reflection.

items.title: Organization coaching
items.description: Support for student and youth organizations on planning and team management.

items.title: Community projects
items.description: Participants design and run small projects that solve a real local problem.

sections.body: Graduates lead student bodies, community programs, and teams with clearer plans and more confidence.
